Company Description
 Software Mind develops solutions that make an impact for companies around the globe. Tech giants & unicorns, transformative projects, emerging technologies, and limitless opportunities – these are a few words that describe an average day for us. Building cross-functional engineering teams that take ownership and crave more means we’re always on the lookout for talented people who bring passion and creativity to every project. Our culture embraces openness, acts with respect, shows grit & guts, and combines delivering results with enjoyment.
 Job Description
 Project – the aim you’ll have
 Join a co-development engagement with a leading UK games studio that builds and ports titles across PC and console. You'll work embedded in the studio's engineering team on an existing real-time engine, delivering performance, rendering and platform work. Game experience is a plus, but strong C++ engineers from simulation, CAD, 3D visualization, AR/VR or media are equally welcome.
 Role – How You’ll Contribute
Develop and optimize high-performance C++ features in an existing real-time engine
Implement and integrate rendering and graphics features with the client's engine team
Profile and tune CPU/GPU performance, memory use and frame times on target platforms
Support porting to new platforms and graphics APIs, writing shaders as needed
Diagnose and fix bugs, including rendering and platform-specific issues
Work with artists, designers and technical artists to deliver performant features
Contribute to tools, build pipelines and automated testing
Join technical planning and code reviews with the client's lead programmers
 Qualifications
 Expectations – the experience you need
5+ years of professional modern C++ (C++14/17 or later) in large production codebases
Performance-oriented engineering: memory layout, cache efficiency and multithreading
Hands-on profiling with tools such as VTune, Visual Studio Profiler, perf, PIX or RenderDoc
Solid 3D math: linear algebra, transforms and coordinate spaces
Experience in games, simulation, CAD/3D visualization, AR/VR, media or embedded
Fluent written and spoken English for daily work with client teams
 Additional Skills – The Edge You Have
Working knowledge of a graphics API (DirectX, Vulkan, OpenGL or Metal) and basic shaders
Unreal Engine (C++) or Unity, especially engine internals or rendering
Shipped commercial titles or console development (PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch)
DirectX 12 or Vulkan, modern rendering (PBR, lighting, post-processing) and GPU profiling
Advanced rendering: ray tracing, upscalers (DLSS/FSR), global illumination
